instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. On an outdoor wooden bridge with green trees in the background, a group of friends stack their hands in a central huddle. On the left, the woman in the gray hijab and pink jacket (R1) is in profile, smiling. In the center background, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) smiles. On the right-center, the woman in the beige hoodie (R4) smiles, while the man in the gray t-shirt (R3) is in the right foreground, seen from a side-back angle. They all extend their hands to stack them together in the center under warm, natural sunlight.
